$comment: Sailing tuning, PRD section 4. Hull, crew and load factors and currents are deferred; they are 1 and 0 for now. World pace is 0.7 of what it was (0.7 tiles/s per speed point) so a passing ship stays on screen long enough to deal with; days are longer to match (calendar.json), and the game cruises at 2x away from coasts and other ships. Wind multipliers are spread so each step up is clearly faster; gale damage risk is not modelled yet.
